reasoning: Hantavirus is a rare disease with limited commercial incentive, and no vaccine candidate has progressed beyond early-phase trials. Full FDA approval typically requires large Phase 3 efficacy data that is infeasible for such a low-incidence pathogen within the 2026 timeframe, making the event exceptionally unlikely.
evidence_points: No Hantavirus vaccine has ever entered Phase 3 trials; historical candidates remained in early development.
Annual U.S. cases of Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome are typically fewer than 50, making large-scale efficacy trials infeasible.
Vaccine development timelines from preclinical to approval usually exceed 5-10 years, even with accelerated pathways.
sources_consulted: Historical clinical trial records for Hantavirus vaccines
